newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Chechen leader to meet on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Chechen leader to meet on Monday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will meet Chechen leader Aslan Maskhadov at noon on Monday, the Kremlin said in a statement.
The Kremlin gave no information about the agenda for the meeting, due to take place in the Kremlin two days after a Russian television crew was kidnapped in the breakaway region.

Yeltsin and Maskhadov had been expected to meet to discuss a deal shaping relations between Moscow and the secessionist southern region. But there has been no indication that the text of the agreement was complete.

Tens of thousands of people died in an ill-fated Russian military operation to crush Chechnya's independence drive. Russia then withdrew its forces and Chechnya promised not to raise the painful issue of its future status until 2001.
Negotiations between Russia and Chechnya, which wants full independence, have been soured by recent explosions in southern Russia and kidnappings in the rebel region.

Both sides denied responsibility for the events, blaming them on "parties of war" which want to wreck the peace process. Russian officials have said talks between Yeltsin and Maskhadov could become more complicated after the crew of NTV commercial television was kidnapped in Chechnya on Saturday.
